Name: Better Artifact Digspots (XNB Mod Update for 1.11)
Author: joyous1ariella
Description:
This is a 1.11 compatibility update for Drogean's mod [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/87/?]Better Artifac[/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/87/?]t Digspots[/url]. All creds go to them.

[i]*****This will not work with any other mods that change the Cursors.xnb file.*****[/i]

Now you can enjoy this mod AND still be able to see Shane's "passed out" sprite! :3

Enjoy!
-Ariella

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Installation:
[list=1]
[*]Navigate to your Stardew Valley game folder and go to the Content-->LooseSprites folder (mine is at C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\LosseSprites)
[*]MAKE A COPY OF Cursors.xnb FOR BACKUP!
[*]Choose ONE of the replacements and extract the .rar to that folder using [url=http://www.rarlab.com/download.htm]WinRar[/url] or similar program and overwrite the file.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Choose this or the egg, NOT BOTH
